hero.headline: AI Tech Meets Farming
hero.subheadline: Kisaan Krushi gives Indian farmers real-time AI-powered weather forecasts, cloud-synced farm profiles, and smart agricultural insights — built with Flutter, powered by Firebase.

features.title: Everything a Farmer Needs
features.subtitle: Built specifically for the Indian farming ecosystem
features.card1Desc: Real-time weather + 5-day forecast based on your GPS location. Fallback to nearest city if location is unavailable.
features.card2Desc: Create your complete farmer profile — stored securely in Firebase Firestore, synced across all your devices.
features.card3Desc: AI technology analyzes weather patterns and farm data to give you intelligent crop and farming recommendations.
features.card4Desc: Sign up and log in safely with Firebase Authentication. Your data is encrypted and private.
features.card5Desc: GPS-powered location intelligence provides hyper-local weather and insights relevant to your exact farm coordinates.
features.card6Desc: All your farm data is automatically backed up to the cloud. Switch phones, never lose your data.

howItWorks.title: Get Started in 3 Simple Steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Install Kisaan Krushi on your Android device. Register with your email to create your secure farmer account in seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Enter your farm details — name, location, crop type, and land area. Your profile is instantly saved to the cloud.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Enable GPS to receive real-time weather and AI-powered farming recommendations tailored to your exact farm location.

about.title: Why Kisaan Krushi?
about.text1: India has over 100 million farmers. Most lack access to real-time, AI-powered agricultural intelligence on their smartphones. Kisaan Krushi bridges that gap — combining Flutter's beautiful UI, Firebase's enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, and OpenWeatherMap's accurate weather data to create a tool that genuinely helps farmers make smarter, more profitable decisions every single day.
about.text2: From Andhra Pradesh rice fields to Telangana cotton farms — Kisaan Krushi is your AI-powered digital farming companion.
about.quote: AI Tech Meets Farming — and changes everything.
